This place is one of the oldest restaurant and is located next to the Nandini road and is famous for Rajasthani food items like  Thali, Dal Bati choorma and rajasthani dessert. Also if you want to order items seperately that also is  option here.
This restaurant is pure vegetarian and mainly serves main course and rajasthani dessert.
Place is quite shady as its very old but the service is very quick.

Tripti Restaurant, located in the bustling Civic Center area, is a well-known dining destination that lives up to its name by offering true satisfaction to its guests. With its welcoming ambiance, quality food, and attentive service, Tripti has established itself as a reliable choice for families, professionals, and food lovers. Based on the overall experience, the restaurant deserves a solid four-star rating.

One of the first things that stands out about Tripti is its pleasant and well-maintained environment. The restaurant features a clean and comfortable interior with tasteful décor that creates a calm and inviting atmosphere. Soft lighting, neatly arranged seating, and good ventilation make it suitable for both casual meals and small gatherings. Whether you are visiting for lunch, dinner, or a special occasion, the ambiance feels relaxed and enjoyable. The Civic Center location adds to its convenience, making it easily accessible for locals as well as visitors.

The food at Tripti is undoubtedly the highlight of the restaurant. The menu offers a wide variety of dishes, focusing mainly on Indian cuisine while also including a few popular multi-cuisine options. From traditional vegetarian meals to rich curries, fresh breads, and flavorful rice dishes, the variety ensures that there is something for everyone. The ingredients used are fresh, and the presentation of the food is appealing without being overly fancy.

The taste of the dishes reflects consistency and balance. The flavors are well-developed, not overly spicy, and suitable for a wide range of preferences. Signature dishes stand out for their aroma and texture, and the portion sizes are generous, providing good value for money. The desserts are also worth mentioning, as they are freshly prepared and provide a satisfying end to the meal.

Service at Tripti is another strong point. The staff members are polite, attentive, and well-trained. They are quick to respond to requests and are happy to help with menu suggestions. Orders are served in a timely manner, and the staff ensures that guests are comfortable throughout their visit. The professionalism of the service team adds to the overall positive dining experience.

Cleanliness and hygiene standards at Tripti are commendable. The dining area, tables, and restrooms are regularly cleaned and well-maintained. This attention to hygiene creates confidence among customers and enhances the overall impression of the restaurant. In today’s times, maintaining such standards is extremely important, and Tripti handles it well.

In terms of pricing, Tripti falls into a moderate range. The prices are reasonable considering the quality of food, service, and location. While it may not be the cheapest option in the area, it certainly offers value for money. The restaurant is suitable for family outings, business lunches, and small celebrations without putting too much pressure on the budget.

Overall, Tripti Restaurant in Civic Center offers a satisfying dining experience with its good food, comfortable ambiance, courteous service, and cleanliness. While there is always room for minor improvements, such as expanding the menu or enhancing décor details, the restaurant performs well in all essential areas. This place is near ghadi chowk, Supela. This is a thali restaurant which means this place is for those who are looking for comple rajasthani meal, in which a variety of dishes are served together on a large platter.

There are options available for thali:
Deluxe(100rs) This is limited thali with 3 Rotis and 2 Veg., Salad and rice and its one time served, a limited refill .(basically limited thali it is)

Unlimited Thali (140rs): This is unlimited thali in which you will have unlimited refills of the food items and 1 sweet ( sweet is one time refill only)

So I have tried the unlimited thali,
Thali was accompanied with: Three different varieties of vegetables, tomato chutney, salad, gulab jamun , Chapati and Rice
